connectcore: Reusable Base for REST and WebSocket Data-Source Connectors

Source: R/connectcore-package.R
connectcore-package.Rd

Shared transport base for R data-source connectors: a configurable REST client (httr2; sync/async; retry; pluggable signing and error handling; pagination) and an event-driven WebSocket client (auto-reconnect, keepalive, watchdog, extensible dispatch). Connector packages extend it instead of re-implementing transport.
